title: AGM/DGM HRBP
description:
**About The Role**
 The Human Resource Business Partner (HRBP) will play a strategic and operational role in shaping people strategy, strengthening workforce capability, and fostering a high‑engagement culture across both corporate and site/project locations. The HRBP will work closely with business leaders and site teams to deliver effective HR solutions, build organization capability, and ensure an engaged, safe, and compliant workplace.
   

  

****Purpose of the Role****
 To partner with business and site leadership teams to implement people strategies, support talent and culture initiatives, and ensure workforce effectiveness across the organization. This role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking, execution excellence, stakeholder influencing, and hands\-on engagement at project sites.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
****1\. Strategic HR Partnership****
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and site leaders on workforce planning, performance management, and organization development.
* Align HR strategies and initiatives with business objectives across corporate and field locations.
* Identify capability gaps, talent risks, and workforce needs through regular business reviews.


****2\. Site Engagement \& Workforce Support****
* Lead and execute employee engagement initiatives at project sites, including site visits, employee connects, and pulse checks.
* Reinforce HR policies, organizational values, and safety culture across all site operations.
* Partner with Site Managers and HSSE teams to maintain workforce morale, address issues, and strengthen employee well‑being.
* Oversee site\-level HR operations such as onboarding, grievance handling, welfare programs, and statutory compliance.
* Monitor site climate indicators—attrition, morale, engagement trends—and propose proactive interventions.
* Build a strong frontline culture through fair practices, recognition programs, and continuous engagement.


****3\. Talent Management \& Development****
* Drive talent reviews, succession planning, and workforce capability‑building initiatives.
* Collaborate with managers to design Individual Development Plans and support career growth pathways.
* Ensure effective execution of performance management cycles (goal setting, mid‑year, annual reviews).


****4\. Employee Lifecycle Management****
* Manage onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and exit processes for both site and corporate employees.
* Address employee concerns with fairness, empathy, and confidentiality while enabling timely resolution.
* Strengthen overall employee experience through connection, transparency, and retention‑focused initiatives.


****5\. Organizational Effectiveness \& Change Management****
* Support business units in restructuring, culture transformation, and digital adoption initiatives.
* Champion diversity \& inclusion, psychological safety, and wellness practices across all locations.


****6\. Policy, Compliance \& Governance****
* Ensure adherence to HR policies, internal governance, and statutory labor compliance across sites.
* Conduct periodic HR audits at project locations to ensure compliance with labor standards and contractor management norms.
* Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Finance, and HSSE teams to streamline workforce‑related processes.


****7\. HR Analytics \& Reporting****
* Analyze workforce metrics such as attrition, attendance, absenteeism, and engagement scores to generate actionable insights.
* Prepare HR dashboards and analytics for leadership decision‑making.
* Track and evaluate the impact of HR initiatives and site engagement programs.


****8\. Stakeholder Management****
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, L\&D, Rewards, HSSE, and HR Ops to deliver integrated people solutions.
* Build strong working relationships with business leaders, site teams, external contractors, and cross‑functional partners.


****Qualifications \& Experience****
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* 4–8 years of progressive HR experience, ideally with exposure to both corporate and distributed site environments.
* Strong understanding of HR functions including talent management, performance management, ER/IR, compensation, and statutory compliance.
* Experience in renewables, infrastructure, EPC, manufacturing, or multi‑site operations is an advantage.


****Skills \& Competencies****
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to navigate complex site environments with empathy, resilience, and assertiveness.
* Analytical aptitude to interpret HR data and derive insights.
* Problem‑solving mindset with a proactive, solution‑oriented approach.
* High integrity, emotional intelligence, and confidentiality in handling sensitive matters.
* Ability to work both independently and within fast‑paced, cross‑functional teams.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a qualified Network Engineer with expertise in Aruba and Juniper networking solutions to provide onsite manpower support as a resident engineer at our client site in Hyderabad. The selected candidate will be responsible for network monitoring, administration, and security device management, ensuring the optimal performance and availability of all network infrastructure.
 



**Mandatory Qualifications** 




**Educational Requirements:** 



* Diploma or BE/B.Tech in Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or Computer Science Engineering (CSE) from a recognized educational institute



**Experience:** 



* Minimum 3 to 4 years of relevant work experience in network administration and support
* **Hands\-on experience with Aruba networking products (switches, wireless controllers, access points)**
* **Hands\-on experience with Juniper networking equipment (switches, routers, firewalls)**



**Certifications (Mandatory):** 



* Valid CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) certification or equivalent networking certification
* **Aruba certification (ACSA/ACMA/ACMP) OR Juniper certification (JNCIA/JNCIS or higher) \- Required**



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Network Monitoring \& Management** 



* Conduct daily monitoring of the health status of all network devices including Aruba switches, Juniper switches/routers, and other network appliances
* Monitor network connectivity and performance across Aruba and Juniper infrastructure
* Ensure optimal network uptime and performance through proactive monitoring
* Perform continuous monitoring of network logs and system alerts from Aruba and Juniper devices



**Network Configuration \& Administration** 



* Configure and reconfigure Aruba switches, wireless controllers, and access points
* Configure and manage Juniper switches, routers, and network devices
* Configure and manage NGFW (Next\-Generation Firewall), WAF (Web Application Firewall), AAA servers, and EMS (Element Management System)
* Implement VLANs, routing protocols, and network segmentation on Aruba and Juniper platforms
* Take regular configuration backups for all network and security devices
* Maintain accurate network configuration documentation and topology diagrams



**Troubleshooting \& Technical Support** 



* Troubleshoot and resolve network connectivity issues on Aruba and Juniper equipment
* Diagnose and fix performance issues related to Aruba wireless infrastructure
* Troubleshoot routing and switching issues on Juniper devices
* Address security incidents affecting network operations
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities in network and security devices
* Apply software patches, firmware updates, and JunOS/ArubaOS upgrades to all network devices
* Log support calls with Aruba, Juniper, and other OEMs for hardware repairs and faulty component replacement
* Coordinate with vendors for RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) processes and technical support escalations



**Network Operations \& Maintenance** 



* Maintain network logs and system logs from Aruba ClearPass, Juniper devices, and other systems in accordance with operational requirements
* Ensure proper log retention as per cybersecurity and compliance standards
* Move log backups to designated storage systems as needed
* Generate network performance reports and status updates
* Provide timely alerts and notifications to management regarding network issues and critical alarms



**Backup \& Documentation** 



* Take regular configuration backups of all Aruba and Juniper devices
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of network changes, incidents, and resolutions
* Document standard operating procedures for Aruba and Juniper network operations



**Required Skills \& Competencies** 




**Technical Skills:** 



* **Strong hands\-on experience with Aruba switching and wireless solutions**
* **Proficiency in Juniper Networks equipment including JunOS configuration and management**
* In\-depth knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP, LACP, etc.)
* Experience with Aruba ClearPass for network access control and AAA services
* Knowledge of Juniper EX/QFX series switches and SRX series firewalls
* Familiarity with Aruba AirWave or Central for wireless network management
* Experience with Aruba Mobility Controllers and Instant Access Points
* Understanding of Juniper Space and network management tools
* Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls (NGFW), WAF, and network security devices
* Experience with network monitoring tools and log management systems
* Understanding of network troubleshooting methodologies and diagnostic tools
* Familiarity with patch management and firmware upgrade processes
* Experience with network backup solutions and configuration management



**Professional Skills:** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with focus on Aruba and Juniper platforms
* Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for multi\-vendor environments
* Effective communication skills for coordinating with Aruba, Juniper, and other vendors
* Ability to work independently and handle day\-to\-day operations with minimal supervision
* Strong attention to detail and methodical approach to network administration
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively
* Customer service orientation with ability to work in client\-facing environment
* Quick learner with ability to adapt to new technologies and platforms



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Both Aruba and Juniper certifications (holding certifications from both vendors is highly desirable)
* Aruba Certified Mobility Professional (ACMP) or Aruba Certified Switching Professional (ACSP)
* Juniper Networks Certified Specialist (JNCIS) or higher level certifications
* Experience with Aruba Fabric Composer (AFC) or Virtual Switching Framework (VSF)
* Knowledge of Juniper Virtual Chassis and EVPN\-VXLAN architectures
* Experience with SD\-WAN solutions from Aruba or Juniper
* Experience working in large enterprise or data center environments



**Working Conditions** 



* This is an onsite position requiring daily presence at the client location in Hyderabad
* Regular day shift operations (Monday to Friday)
* May require occasional extended hours during network maintenance windows or critical incidents
* Direct coordination with client IT teams and external vendors (Aruba, Juniper, etc.)



**What We Offer** 



* Full\-time employment with career stability and growth opportunities
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise\-level Aruba and Juniper networking infrastructure
* Opportunity to work with advanced network technologies and security devices
* Professional development and networking skill enhancement with industry\-leading platforms
* Exposure to large\-scale network operations and management
* Opportunity to enhance expertise in Aruba and Juniper technologies
* Competitive compensation and benefits package



**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates meeting the above requirements should submit their updated resume along with:
 


* Copies of educational certificates (Diploma/BE/B.Tech)
* Valid CCNA or equivalent certification
* **Valid Aruba OR Juniper certification (mandatory)**
* Detailed work experience summary highlighting relevant Aruba and Juniper projects (minimum 3\-4 years)
* Brief description of hands\-on experience with Aruba and Juniper equipment

At Cepheid, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Develop, edit, and publish clear, accurate Instructions for Use (IFUs), Quick Reference Instructions, and other regulatory\-compliant documents for Cepheid’s Xpert tests.
* Manage the end\-to\-end creation of documentation, including operator’s manuals, user guides, getting started guides, and service manuals for Cepheid’s instrument systems.
* Drive quality and consistency by reviewing and peer\-reviewing publications for content accuracy, format, and adherence to Cepheid’s style guide.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) and cross\-functional teams to gather, verify, and validate technical information, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate.
* Coordinate translation requests with external suppliers, format post\-translation documents, and manage the release of final documentation in Cepheid’s system.


**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences with 6–12 years of technical writing experience in the biotech industry.
* Proficiency in XML/DITA CCMS, Adobe FrameMaker, Acrobat, Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Microsoft Word, and ABBYY FineReader; experience developing DITA styling for online documentation.
* Strong command of English grammar, punctuation, and writing, with attention to detail, accuracy, and adherence to policies, procedures, and style guides.
* Experience participating in product development teams, creating and updating SOPs, and conducting verification and validation of technical publications.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills with the ability to prioritize, multi\-task, and work with focused urgency as required by project timelines.


**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**
* Proficiency in preparing images for technical documentation and modifying CSS for enhanced output styling.
* Experience in medical equipment writing and familiarity with Agile documentation systems.

description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* Required: 3\-5 Yrs of experience in Python development with experience in building and operating production\-grade data acquisition and extraction systems
* Required: Strong hands\-on experience in at least one additional language (e.g., Java, C\#, Go, C\+\+, or Rust) to inform sound system design
* Required: Experience designing, deploying, and operating scalable and resilient pipelines with strong observability (monitoring, logging) and incident response practices
* Required: Strong engineering discipline in continuous integration/continuous delivery, automated testing, and production readiness. Proven ability to run software in a production cloud environment (e.g., AWS, Azure)
* Required: Proven ability to deliver iteratively on a regular cadence (for example, biweekly releases) and improve reliability and performance over time
* Preferred: Experience with web data acquisition, anti\-bot techniques, and processing unstructured content (for example, HTML, PDF, XML) into validated structured datasets
* Preferred: Experience integrating machine learning or large language model\-based extraction approaches into production workflows
* Preferred: Familiarity with Python async frameworks (asyncio) and web scraping tools (BeautifulSoup, Selenium/Playwright)
* Preferred: Experience with distributed processing, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Airflow)


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


**Responsibilities**
* Build and operate scalable web data acquisition and extraction pipelines, delivering high\-quality structured datasets from complex unstructured sources
* Design, build, and maintain production\-grade data acquisition pipelines for global regulatory and government sources
* Implement anti\-bot and resilience strategies (for example, proxy rotation, headless browser automation, and CAPTCHA handling) to improve crawl success and stability
* Build robust extraction workflows to process unstructured documents (for example, HTML, PDF, XML) into validated structured datasets
* Integrate acquisition outputs with downstream enrichment workflows to support tagging, linkage, classification, and dataset usability
* Deliver improvements and new production capabilities on a regular cadence (for example, every two weeks), including new sources, extraction enhancements, and reliability upgrades
* Establish and maintain continuous integration/continuous delivery practices, including automated testing, monitoring, and operational runbooks as needed
* Pilot and productionize at least one large language model\-based parsing workflow, improving extraction accuracy for complex document types
* Collaborate with machine learning engineers on prompt engineering and fine\-tuning initiatives to enhance metadata extraction and entity resolution
* Implement feedback mechanisms (for example, tracking interfaces or application programming interfaces) so downstream consumers can submit corrections and enhancements, and use that feedback to drive continuous quality improvement


**About The Team**
 Our Unstructured Data Team is responsible for building a cost\-efficient, fast, self\-service, controlled\-risk data acquisition and extraction platform at scale. Our team contributes to Moody’s by:
   

  

* Delivering high\-quality datasets from diverse web and regulatory sources to support strategic business and analytics use cases
* Improving data freshness, reliability, and enrichment to increase downstream decision\-making quality
* Advancing automation capabilities, including production integration of large language models to improve extraction and entity resolution


 By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in large\-scale web data acquisition, unstructured document processing, data pipeline engineering, and production AI\-assisted extraction across global source coverage.
   

  

 Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

The role owns front‑end execution for assigned workstreams, translating approved designs into accessible, performant, production‑ready interfaces aligned to brand standards and client requirements.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
The Human Resource Manager will be responsible for managing all HR functions including **recruitment, employee engagement, performance management, HR policies, and organizational development**. The role requires building a strong workforce, maintaining a healthy work environment, and aligning HR strategies with company goals.

Human Resource Managers typically plan and coordinate the administrative functions of an organization, oversee recruitment, and act as a bridge between management and employees.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage the complete recruitment process including **job posting, screening, interviewing, and onboarding**.
* Hire candidates for roles such as developers, designers, sales executives, and interns.
* Develop recruitment strategies to attract skilled IT professionals.

2\. Employee Management

* Maintain employee records, contracts, and HR documentation.
* Handle employee queries, grievances, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure smooth communication between management and employees.

3\. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop and implement company **HR policies and procedures**.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and employment regulations.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.

4\. Performance Management

* Implement employee **performance review and appraisal systems**.
* Monitor productivity and support employee development plans.
* Work with department heads to improve team performance.

5\. Training \& Development

* Identify training needs and organize workshops or skill development sessions.
* Coordinate training programs for technical and non\-technical staff.
* Support career growth and learning opportunities for employees.

6\. Payroll \& Benefits Administration

* Coordinate payroll processing, salary structures, and benefits.
* Manage employee leave records, attendance, and incentives.
* Ensure fair compensation and benefits policies.

7\. Employee Engagement \& Culture

* Create initiatives to maintain a **positive work culture and employee satisfaction**.
* Organize team activities, events, and recognition programs.
* Promote collaboration and teamwork within the organization.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field**.
* 3–5 years of experience in HR management or recruitment.
* Strong knowledge of **HR policies, recruitment processes, and labor laws**.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience with **HR software, HRIS systems, or recruitment tools**.
* Strong leadership and organizational abilities.

Preferred Skills

* Experience hiring for **IT, software development, or digital marketing roles**.
* Knowledge of **employee performance management systems**.
* Ability to handle **multiple recruitment processes simultaneously**.

title: HR Manager
description:
**OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a hands\-on HR Manager to independently own the entire people function for a growing team operating across India and the UAE. This is not a corporate HR role — you will be building HR infrastructure from the ground up in a fast\-paced startup environment.

You will handle everything from recruiting and onboarding to payroll coordination, performance management, compliance, employee engagement, and exit management. We need someone who combines strong HR fundamentals with startup pragmatism — someone who can draft a proper employment contract AND have a tough conversation about performance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding**

Manage end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and background verification. Execute structured onboarding with Day 1 checklists, tool access, policy walkthroughs, and 30\-day check\-ins.

**Payroll \& Compliance**

Coordinate monthly payroll processing and verification. Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws (PF, ESI, PT) and UAE labor law basics. Maintain audit\-ready employee records and documentation.

**Performance Management**

Implement review cycles: goal setting, check\-ins, and quarterly/annual reviews. Manage PIPs with proper documentation. Coordinate salary reviews and increments based on performance data.

**Employee Engagement**

Conduct monthly 1\-on\-1 check\-ins with all employees. Plan team activities and recognition programs. Manage grievances with confidentiality. Run quarterly engagement surveys.

**Policy \& Reporting**

Maintain the Employee Handbook and HR policies. Deliver monthly HR dashboards: headcount, attrition, open positions, payroll costs. Benchmark compensation against market data.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Must\-Have**

* 3–7 years of HR generalist experience, with at least 1–2 years managing HR independently for a small company (10–50 employees).
* Hands\-on experience with Indian payroll, PF, ESI, and labor compliance.
* Proven recruitment experience: personally hired 15\+ employees across technical and non\-technical roles.
* Experience managing performance reviews, PIPs, and difficult employee conversations.
* Strong documentation skills: employment contracts, policies, and professional communications.
* Proficiency in HR tools (HRMS/HRIS) and Excel for payroll and reporting.
* Excellent English communication (written and verbal).
* High integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Experience with UAE labor law (MOHRE, WPS, visa processing).
* Experience in an IT services or SaaS startup environment.
* HR certification (SHRM\-CP, PHR, or Indian equivalent).
* Experience managing distributed/remote teams across countries.
* MBA in HR or equivalent qualification.

title: HR & Admin Executive
description:
**About RAS Luxury Skincare**

RAS Luxury Skincare is a premium, science\-backed skincare brand rooted in the belief that real ingredients deliver real results. We are a lean, high\-performing team where every individual — including our founders — rolls up their sleeves and gets things done. Our culture is collaborative, ego\-free, and deeply invested in excellence at every level.

**Role Overview**

This is a one\-person powerhouse role. The Senior Executive – HR, Admin \& Operations is the backbone of the Mumbai office — responsible for keeping the workplace running seamlessly, building a great team, and ensuring every employee has a positive experience from Day 1\.

This role requires someone who is equally comfortable writing a recruitment brief, onboarding a new joiner, resolving a laptop issue, and stepping in to make sure a cabin is set up correctly before an important meeting. At RAS, no task is beneath anyone — our founders and senior leadership lead by example in this regard, and we expect the same from this role.

**A Note on Culture \& Mindset**

At RAS, we believe that the best leaders are hands\-on. Whether it is our founders or a VP, no one considers any task too small if it serves the team or the brand. A few examples of what this looks like in practice:

On office \& operations: If the housekeeping staff has missed placing water glasses in a cabin before a meeting, our Senior Executive does not escalate or wait — they place the glasses themselves and then address the root cause with the housekeeper afterwards.

On recruitment: If a strong candidate has not heard back in three days and is likely to drop off, our Senior Executive does not wait for a reminder from the hiring manager — they pick up the phone, keep the candidate warm, and follow up internally to get a decision. A good candidate lost to slow process is a failure we take personally.

On onboarding: If a new joiner's laptop is not ready on Day 1, our Senior Executive does not shrug and say the IT vendor is delayed — they arrange an interim solution, sit with the joiner through their first\-day setup, and make sure the person feels genuinely welcomed, not just processed. First impressions of a company are set in the first 48 hours.

On making people feel secure: Employees should never feel like they are in the dark about where they stand. Our Senior Executive proactively checks in — especially with newer team members — to ensure they feel supported, heard, and clear on expectations. A settled, secure team performs better. That is not soft work; it is strategic.

On performance \& feedback: This role is also a trusted channel for the leadership team. If someone on the team is underperforming, struggling, or creating friction, our Senior Executive is expected to have honest, constructive conversations — both to support the individual and to keep leadership informed. This requires courage, tact, and complete confidentiality. It is not about managing people out; it is about helping people grow, and being clear when growth is not happening.

**This is not an exception; it is an expectation. If you bring ego to this role, this is not the right place for you. If you bring ownership, empathy, and the courage to do hard things well — you will thrive here.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

– Own end\-to\-end recruitment: write JDs, post on relevant platforms, source candidates, screen resumes

– Shortlist candidates based on role fitment and coordinate interview schedules with hiring managers

– Coordinate and confirm all interview logistics — in\-person and virtual

– Ensure timely follow\-up with candidates at every stage; maintain a positive candidate experience

– Collect structured interview feedback from the reporting manager within 24 hours of each interview

– Maintain a recruitment tracker and provide weekly status updates to leadership

– Build a pipeline of passive candidates for recurring roles

2\. Onboarding \& Induction

– Execute a structured, warm, and professional onboarding experience for every new joiner

– Prepare offer letters, employment documentation, and Day 1 readiness kits

– Coordinate system access, ID cards, workstation setup, and equipment allocation before the joining date

– Conduct the induction session covering company history, culture, values, team introductions, and policies

– Ensure the new joiner meets all key stakeholders in the first week

– Schedule 30\-day and 60\-day check\-ins and capture early feedback from both joiner and reporting manager

3\. Employee Welfare, Engagement \& Grievance Handling

– Be the go\-to person for employees with concerns, queries, or requests — approachable and discreet

– Plan and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations, and milestone events

– Maintain a calendar of birthdays, work anniversaries, and team events

– Handle grievances with sensitivity and confidentiality; escalate to leadership only when truly necessary

– Gather periodic pulse feedback from employees and share actionable insights with leadership

– Ensure HR policies are clearly communicated and consistently applied

4\. Scheduling \& Coordination

– Manage interview scheduling, induction calendars, and leadership meeting coordination

– Handle logistics for internal events, offsite meetings, and team gatherings

– Maintain accurate records: attendance, leave, HR documentation, vendor contracts

– Prepare and share regular reports on open positions, headcount, and admin status with leadership

5\. Administration \& Facility Management

– Ensure the Mumbai office is clean, well\-stocked, and fully operational at all times

– Manage housekeeping staff — set daily task schedules, conduct spot checks, and hold them accountable for quality

– Be the first line of response for any facility issue: if something is not right, fix it first and investigate second

– Manage vendor relationships: office supplies, pantry, maintenance, courier, utilities

– Maintain office inventory and raise purchase requests proactively — never let the office run out of essentials

– Coordinate asset allocation and maintenance (furniture, equipment, appliances)

– Ensure meeting rooms and cabins are set up correctly before every meeting — water, stationery, AV, cleanliness

6\. IT Support \& Coordination

– Be the first point of contact for day\-to\-day IT issues: connectivity, software access, hardware problems

– Coordinate with external IT vendors for resolution of issues that require specialised support

– Manage software licenses, tool subscriptions, and access management for the office

– Ensure all new joiners have fully configured systems and required software access on Day 1

– Maintain an asset register for all IT equipment and ensure timely servicing or replacement

We are looking for a visionary **Lead AI Creative Technologist / AI Design Superstar** to revolutionize our in\-house marketing operations. We already have a stellar, fully\-equipped team of developers, traditional designers, video editors, and marketers. Now, we need a "10x creative leader" to sit at the helm of our AI strategy, supercharging our existing team's capabilities and building the future of our brand's visual and written storytelling.

You are a creative technologist, a master prompt engineer, a system builder, and a storyteller. You will not just generate assets; you will build custom AI workflows, write compelling scripts, design storyboards, and lead our marketing department into the next generation of creative production. If you know how to blend world\-class creative direction with the most advanced generative AI tools to cut timelines in half and unlock endless possibilities, we want you to lead our team.

**What You Will Build \& Execute**

* **Lead the AI Marketing Strategy:** Act as the central hub for all AI\-driven creative initiatives, upskilling our current team of designers and video editors to integrate AI into their daily workflows.
* **Screenwriting \& Storyboarding:** Conceptualize, write, and storyboard high\-performing video ads, campaigns, and content. **(Excellent English writing skills are an absolute must for this role).**
* **End\-to\-End AI Production Workflows:** Design and implement automated, AI\-powered systems for everything from static image generation to full\-scale video creation, ensuring we produce assets at unprecedented speed and scale.
* **Digital Personas, Voice Cloning \& Video:** Develop realistic digital avatars, generate AI voiceovers (matching our brand tone), and use AI to enhance video footage, motion graphics, and B\-roll.
* **Custom Brand Image Libraries:** Generate thousands of photorealistic and abstract visuals that are 100% unique and strictly adhere to our brand guidelines—eliminating the need for expensive photoshoots.
* **Rapid Idea Testing:** Use generative AI to quickly explore a massive range of concepts, allowing our marketing team to A/B test fresh, original copy and visuals faster than ever before.

**What Makes You a Superstar (Requirements)**

* **Impeccable English Writing Skills:** You must have native\-level or exceptionally fluent English writing abilities. You will be responsible for writing compelling video scripts, crafting detailed storyboards, and generating high\-converting marketing copy.
* **Mastery of the Modern AI Stack:** Deep, hands\-on expertise with the most advanced AI tools on the market. You should be highly proficient in:
* **Image Generation:** Midjourney, DALL\-E 3, Stable Diffusion (ComfyUI/Automatic1111\), Adobe Firefly.
* **Video \& Motion:** Runway (Gen\-2/Gen\-3\), Pika Labs, Luma Dream Machine, Topaz Video AI.
* **Avatars \& Voice:** ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Synthesia.
* **LLMs \& Copywriting:** ChatGPT (GPT\-4o), Claude 3\.5 Sonnet, Jasper/Copy.ai.
* **Design \& Workflow:** Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Zapier/Make (for automating creative pipelines).
* **Strong Traditional Creative Foundation:** You have years of experience as an art director, copywriter, or creative lead. You know that AI is just a tool, and your human intuition, emotional intelligence, and understanding of visual/written language are what make the final product great.
* **Systems \& Leadership Thinker:** You don't just create one\-off images; you build scalable systems, custom AI models (like training LoRAs for brand consistency), and repeatable processes that multiply the output of our entire marketing department.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Leadership \& Autonomy:** You will be the foundational pillar of our AI creative operations, with the autonomy to build the tech stack, dictate workflows, and lead a talented, multi\-disciplinary team.
* **Massive Impact:** Your work will directly drive our marketing success, allowing us to punch far above our weight class in visual and written storytelling.
* **Cutting\-Edge Focus:** We will provide the resources and budget for you to continuously test and integrate the newest AI models the second they hit the market.

**Ready to lead the future of our brand? Apply today with a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your English copywriting/scripting skills, traditional creative excellence, and advanced AI generation capabilities.**

**Job Title: Human Resources \- Sr. Manager** 




**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi (Netaji Subhash Place)
 



**Reports To:** 
 \[Director]
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 The HR Manager is responsible for overseeing all aspects of human resources practices and processes. They support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The role includes managing activities such as recruitment, employee relations, performance management, training \& development, compensation, and ensuring legal compliance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Recruitment \& Onboarding:** 



* Manage the full recruitment cycle: job postings, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding.
* Collaborate with department heads to understand hiring needs and workforce planning.



**Employee Relations:** 



* Handle employee grievances, conflicts, and disciplinary procedures.
* Foster a positive work environment and ensure employee engagement.



**HR Policies \& Compliance:** 



* Develop, update, and implement HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws and company standards.



**Performance Management:** 



* Oversee the performance appraisal process.
* Guide managers and employees on performance improvement plans and career development.



**Training \& Development:** 



* Identify training needs and coordinate learning and development initiatives.
* Monitor training effectiveness.



**Payroll \& Benefits:** 



* Coordinate with the finance department for payroll processing.
* Administer employee benefits, leave management, and attendance.



**HR Analytics \& Reporting:** 



* Maintain HR records and prepare HR metrics reports (e.g., turnover, headcount).
* Use data to inform decision\-making and strategic planning.



**ISO Audit:** 



* Ensure HR processes comply with ISO standards by maintaining proper documentation, records, and policies as per audit requirements.
* Coordinate and support internal and external ISO audits, including preparation of HR\-related documents and compliance reports.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (MBA preferred).
* 13\+ years of HR experience, with at least 8 years in a managerial role.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.



  





**How to Apply:** 



* Send your updated CV to hr.nsp@ambraneindia.com with subject line
 **“Sr. HR Manager – Ambrane India”.**

title: Senior Manager Total Rewards (CoE)
description:
**Position Purpose**
 Manage the Performance and Rewards responsibilities for assigned countries/businesses within India and 40\+ countries in Emerging Markets for effective design and implementation of commercial, compliant and business\-relevant strategies, policies and programmes, aligned to the overall P\&R strategy and policies.
   

  

 The incumbent will research best practice and keep abreast of legislative and market change to provide expert advice to HR and the business leaders and lead the various projects and regular
   

  

 initiatives under the Rewards domain.
   

  

**Your Tasks And Responsibilities**
* Annual Compensation Review Cycle: Design and program manage the Annual Compensation Review cycle for the responsible countries to ensure complete budget management and timeline adherence. Use statistical methods and techniques to make data\-based decisions on various aspects of compensations. Deploy effective communication strategies and success metrics
* Sales/Productivity Linked Incentives/Variable Pay, Retention, Severance Plans: Manage the annual variable pay process execution through effective coordination with Finance and other internal stakeholders to ensure timely pay\-out finalization with appropriate approvals. Design appropriate solutions to address critical business requirements around employee motivation, retention and productivity enhancement
* Benefits Management: Work with Head Rewards to ensure smooth deployment and maintenance of key employee benefits in different countries. Participate in benchmarking studies to ensure competitiveness of our benefits
* Benchmarking \& Market Intelligence: Commission custom surveys and also participate in industry salary benchmarking surveys to determine prevailing pay rates and benefits and analyze these for building internal proposals on salary reviews and policy changes. Conduct ongoing research into emerging trends, issues and best practices.
* People Policy Framework: Develop a comprehensive policy framework covering all elements of an employee lifecycle in the organization. Ensure adherence to the published policy documents across the organization. Conduct periodic audits and prepare reports. Assess the effectiveness of policies and processes and proactively recommend new and innovative approaches and solutions
* International Mobility \& Expat Management: Support ongoing expat management for the responsible countries including package determination and compliance requirements
* Job Evaluations and Grade Structuring: Support any special projects in job grading and Job evaluations as per the organization’s policy. Partner with HR and business leaders to maintain an appropriate grade structure and ensure effective governance
* Performance Management Strategy \& Annual PMS process: Support the design and execution of annual performance management process for the assigned business/countries. Act as an SME and guide the HR generalists and line leaders in defining objective business, team and individual level scorecards to strengthen the performance management architecture.
* Design and delivery of manager/employee communication and training on all these initiatives: Develop and execute appropriate communication and training programmes for manager/employee capability building in specific P\&R areas to ensure effective implementation and realise improved business performance
* HR Analytics: Develop and set standards around key HR metrics with focus on analytics around compensation spends and wage management
* Business As Usual: Work with other members in the team to ensure smooth delivery of Rewards services to employees ranging from handling manager queries, partnering with HRBP to support business needs to process promotion and salary increase periodic cycles.


 Manage the implementation of relevant TR \& PMS policies and programmes within the business and coordinate the relevant key strategic processes, working through Generalists to interface with the business
   

  

 Maintain expert specialist knowledge by keeping abreast of published materials, competitor practice, external market developments and trends and legislative and regulatory developments
   

  

**Who You Are**
* 3–5 years’ experience in HR, at least 2 years of experience in CoE Compensation \& Benefits
* MBA in HR (prefer Tier1 institute like XLRI, TISS, XIMB etc.)
* Deep understanding of compensation structures, incentive plans and benefits
* Proficiency in Excel, HR Analytics and Data Visualization
* Excellent stakeholder management skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills

We focus on creating bespoke interior experiences for residential, commercial, and corporate spaces. Join our dynamic team to contribute to the growth and success of our brand while nurturing talent and fostering a positive workplace culture.

title: People Manager EMSX , EMSX
description:
**Description**
 Join the Seller AI team where you'll lead benchmarking and evaluation of AI models that enhance the seller experience across Amazon's global marketplace. You'll manage a team dedicated to validating, testing, and improving Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) that power innovative seller tools. This role combines strategic leadership with hands\-on technical oversight, requiring exceptional communication skills, team management, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 In this position, you'll drive the development and implementation of comprehensive benchmarking methodologies to evaluate AI model performance across accuracy, robustness, bias, and reliability metrics. Your expertise will be crucial in translating technical findings into actionable insights that improve Seller Assistant's performance and contribute to the growth of Amazon's seller community worldwide.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Plan and execute benchmarking exercises for AI models, defining test plans, metrics, and acceptance criteria across accuracy, robustness, bias, and reliability dimensions
* Lead a team responsible for validating data based on specific annotation guidelines, ensuring accuracy and quality while escalating potential regulatory risks
* Prepare comprehensive audit and benchmarking reports, including error ratings, root\-cause analysis, and recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Drive process efficiencies and explore automation opportunities to enhance the productivity of data generation initiatives
* Mentor team members and help develop their skills while managing overall schedules, proactively mitigating risks, and keeping project scope under control.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day begins with prioritizing benchmarking tasks for your team based on current business requirements. You'll review progress on ongoing audits, provide guidance where needed, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. Throughout the day, you'll analyze performance data from Seller Assistant tools, identifying patterns and insights that could improve AI model effectiveness. You'll wrap up by preparing detailed presentations that showcase your team's findings and recommendations to leadership, highlighting opportunities to enhance the seller experience.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Seller AI team within International Seller Services is dedicated to creating Gen\-AI/LLM powered tools and agentic solutions that accelerate business growth for Amazon sellers worldwide. We focus on handling annotations for training, measuring, and improving Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models to deliver superior seller experiences. Our team combines technical expertise with a deep understanding of seller needs to develop innovative solutions that simplify complex tasks and drive business growth.
   

  

 By joining us, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of selling on Amazon, working with cutting\-edge AI technologies that directly impact millions of sellers across global marketplaces.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree, or MBA in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources or related field
* \- Min. 5 to 8 years of exp. as a People Manager with good communication skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in people management


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. This includes partnering with business leaders to shape the talent, workforce, and total rewards strategies as well as operational processes and systems needed to support unique business models and build an environment where employees can develop, contribute and thrive. This role will require you to roll up your sleeves and engage on a hands\-on basis. High business acumen, manager coaching and excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential. Role would involve travel as needed within India and APAC countries and flexibility to work across different timezones including coordinating with the global PXT HRBP team in Americas.

* Serve as the APAC Regional HRBP leader for PXT organizations

* Function as a thought partner and coach to key leaders and their respective organizations

* Use strong analytical skills to tell the story around the operational metrics and supporting data and provide actionable insights to raise the bar on organizational performance and drive path\-to\-green plans as needed.

**Basic Qualifications**

 In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.

* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.


**Career Development and Global Exposure**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will be focused on monitoring, managing and maintaining the Barry\-Wehmiller global network. You'll work closely with engineering teams and with various vendors and partners (including hardware vendors, local IT support, Datacenter and network providers, and ISPs) to maintain and improve our global infrastructure. This role ensures the maximum uptime performance, and security of critical systems and services. This is a highly visible position that requires deep technical understanding of enterprise networks infrastructure, networking (physical), and basic experience with data analysis.
   

  

 To be successful in this position, you should have excellent technical skills, communication skills, and be able to navigate a range of challenges and constraints (e.g. schedule adherence, time zones, and cultures).
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You are detail\-oriented, eager to learn, and excited to grow your career in a fast\-paced, global infrastructure environment. You bring foundational knowledge of enterprise networks, datacentre environments, networking, and Linux systems, and are motivated to support mission\-critical operations. You’re comfortable following established processes, working across time zones, and collaborating with global teams. You will be working with partners to support infrastructure to a number of remote locations. You will have had experience managing operational environments and used to developing new approaches to improve efficiency or operational stability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Monitor, analyze, and maintain global SD\-WAN infrastructure \& enterprise networks using NOC monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Zabbix \& Meraki Dashboard)
* Respond to network incidents and performance degradations, performing L2 troubleshooting across SD\-WAN, LAN, WAN, VOIP, Perimeter and VPN environments.
* Coordinate with carriers, vendors, and internal network engineering teams for incident escalation and resolution.
* Perform proactive link performance analysis, identify chronic network issues, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in on\-call rotations and provide 24x7 support coverage as part of the NOC operations model.
* Support and optimize routing policies (BGP, OSPF) and QoS configurations to ensure traffic prioritization and SLA adherence.
* Generate performance and availability reports and contribute to incident trend analysis and problem management reviews.


**Technical Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience with event logging \& network monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, Zabbix, PRTG \& Splunk.
* 3\+ years of experience with SD\-WAN solutions (Meraki, Viptela, Versa etc)
* 2\+ years of experience with Meraki appliances (MX, MS)
* Experience with any one of CSPs (Azure , AWS or GCP)
* Deep understanding of the OSI model \& Solid knowledge of TCP/IP
* Experience with packet captures and analysis with Wireshark.
* Key skills for L2 protocols are Spanning Tree modes PVST\+, RSTP, LACP, 802\.1q, VTP, VLAN, ARP \& EtherChannel
* Key skills for L3 network protocols are EIGRP, OSPF \& BGP
* Experience with IPSec, IPAM, DHCP, DNS and authentication such as Radius/TACACS.
* General networking and security troubleshooting (Firewalls, Load Balancers, Proxies, Routing \& Switching)
* Experience with one of Cisco FTD, Palo Alto or Fortinet Firewalls.
* Basic Scripting and development skills with knowledge\& understanding of regular expressions, APIs \&webhooks.
* Familiarity with key events on common IT platforms
* Basic understanding of Microsoft technologies, e.g. AD, Windows Server, Hyper V, Exchange O365, SQL Server, Microsoft Dynamics, IIS, Azure and web hosting


**Key Attributes:**
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset. (SRE Mindset)
* Willing to work in rotational shifts including nights shifts and on\-call.
* Ability to thrive in high\-pressure, fast\-paced environments.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross\-functional and cross\-regional teams.
* Commitment to operational excellence and continuous learning.
* Natural bar\-raiser: curious and passionate, with a desire to continuously learn more.


**Preferred Certifications (Not Mandatory)**
 CCNP, ITIL, Fortinet, Palo Alto \& Cloud Certifications

 Previous hands\-on working experience with Meraki \& Palo Alto network gear

* Experience using traffic generators (Ixia/Spirent/TRex) for performance and feature validation.

title: Founding AI Technical Writer
description:
**📍 Remote (India) \| Full\-time** 




  





**We work with AI\-native companies that need technical content their developers actually want to read. We're looking for a founding technical writer who can research deeply, write clearly, and optimize for both search engines and generative engines.** 




  





**This isn't a role where you get a brief and disappear. You'll own the content strategy, work directly with clients, and make sure every piece we publish ranks and performs.** 




  




**What You'll Do** 

  





**🔍 Research and Write Technical Content** 




  





**You'll create content for AI companies building LLMs, agents, RAG systems, and developer tools.** 




**This means:** 




  




* Writing 8\-12 technical blog posts per month that explain complex AI concepts clearly
* Creating newsletters that engineers and founders actually open
* Producing case studies and whitepapers that demonstrate real technical value
* Writing on Reddit to share insights and drive meaningful discussion
* Creating social posts that cut through the noise



  





 Every piece requires deep research. You'll read documentation, interview engineers, test products, and understand the technology before you write about it.
 



  





**📈 Master SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)** 




  





**Every blog we publish should rank. You'll:** 




  




* Optimize content for Google, Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Claude
* Create dedicated GEO pages for clients to maximize visibility in AI search
* Plan content refreshes to keep rankings strong
* Track what's working and iterate based on performance



  





 You'll need to learn GEO if you haven't worked with it yet. This is emerging, and we're figuring it out as the space evolves.
 



  





**🎯 Own the Results** 




  





**You're not just writing. You're responsible for traffic, engagement, backlinks, and conversions. If something isn't working, you figure out why and fix it.** 




  




**Who You Are** 

  





 ✅
 **You Have Technical Depth** 



* You've written technical content before (AI, ML, developer tools, or similar fields)
* You understand how to read documentation and explain APIs, models, and systems
* You're comfortable talking to engineers and translating their work into clear stories



 ✅
 **You Use AI Tools Daily** 



* You already use Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or similar tools to research and write faster
* You understand how AI is changing content creation
* You're experimenting with new tools and workflows constantly



 ✅
 **You're a Generalist** 



* You can switch between writing a technical blog, creating a GEO page, planning content refreshes, and writing on Reddit in the same week
* You don't need someone to tell you exactly what to do. You figure it out.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and building things from scratch



 ✅
 **You Care About Outcomes** 



* You track metrics: traffic, time on page, backlinks, conversions
* You kill what doesn't work and double down on what does
* You want your content to drive real business results for clients



 ✅
 **You Work Independently** 



* You don't need detailed briefs or constant check\-ins
* You research, propose ideas, and execute on your own
* You're fine with: "Here's the client, here's the goal. Figure out the best approach."



  




**What We Offer** 

  





 🌍
 **Fully remote.** 
 Work from anywhere in India.
 



 🚀
 **Founding role.** 
 You'll shape how we create content for AI companies from day one.
 



 🤖
 **AI\-first environment.** 
 We use the best tools and expect you to do the same.
 



 💼
 **Direct client work.** 
 You'll be on calls with AI companies, understanding what they're building and creating content that drives their growth.
 



 📚
 **Fast learning.** 
 You'll work with cutting\-edge AI companies and see what's being built before it's public.
 



  




**This Role Is Not For You If:** 

  





 ❌ You want a predictable 9\-to\-5 with the same tasks every week
 



 ❌ You need someone to give you detailed instructions for every piece you write
 



 ❌ You're a generalist writer who can write about anything but doesn't care about the technology
 



 ❌ You're not comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter
 



 ❌ You need stability over learning and building
 



  




**How to Apply** 

  





 📧 Send an email to
 **sumanth@devable.ai** 
 with:
 



  





**1\. Your best technical writing sample** 




  





**Link to one published piece. Ideally about AI, ML, or developer tools. We want to see technical depth and clear writing.** 




  





**2\. A short pitch (200 words max)** 




  





**Tell us:** 




  




* Why this role specifically excites you
* One piece of content you'd create for an AI company in your first month and how you'd make sure it ranks
* How you currently use AI tools in your writing process



  





**3\. Your LinkedIn profile** 




  





**That's it. No formal resume needed.** 




  





**Subject line:** 
 Founding Technical Writer \- \[Your Name]
 



  





 All the best! 🚀

description:
**Overview**
 The Microsoft Security organization’s mission of making the world a safer place has never been more important. As threats become more frequent and sophisticated, we drive improvements into our security products that keep our customers, apps, and their devices safe. Security is one of the fastest growing, collaborative, fun teams with a startup mindset within Microsoft. The Microsoft Defender family offers comprehensive threat prevention, detection, and response capabilities for everyone – from individuals looking to protect their family to the world’s largest enterprises.
   

  

 Linux servers run very business critical workloads for our customers. These have become very attractive targets for the attackers to create havoc for our customers. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides a security solution to protect the Linux Servers with high performance, quality, and more importantly innovative security solutions. We are hiring a Principal Engineering manager for this business/product.
   

  

 Providing “Peace of mind” to our customers with our security solutions is what excites us every day! Our team has people from a wide variety of backgrounds, previous work history, and life experiences, and we are eager to maintain and grow that diversity. We are passionate about learning on the job, collaborating with other teams, and being customer obsessed. Come join us if you are passionate about positively impacting over a billion users from all walks of life through easy\-to\-use cyber security products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop, test, and maintain extensible and reusable code, identifying and addressing coding issues, and conducting effective code reviews, deployment, scale, performance and quality, from conception to delivery.
* Work closely with a geographically distributed team, including product managers, security researchers, and developers, to develop key product improvements.
* The features that you build must be of high quality and must meet all the quality criteria for a feature release.
* Uphold and promote the organizational culture and values, fostering an environment of innovation, quality, and accountability.


**Qualifications**
* 3\-6 years of experience as a software engineer working on enterprise software and a proven track record of having shipped commercially successful software products \& services.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multi\-disciplinary team consisting of Software Engineers, Program Managers, Security researchers, and Data Scientists.
* Familiar with Linux Internals and experience in building Linux products.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Familiar with secure software development life cycle.
* Experience with software development tools such as source control systems (GIT), automated build systems, compilers, software validation systems, project tracking, and lifecycle management systems.
* Work independently, drive technical and architectural dependencies.
* BS or MS degree in Computer Science

title: HR Generalist
description:
As our HR Generalist, you will be the backbone of our HR \& Talent Acquisition operations and the support to the Head of HR. In this role, you will take ownership of our operational framework, ensuring that every process, from drafting contracts to managing precise monthly payroll, is executed timely and accurately. By managing BambooHR and taking ownership of our recruitment workflows, you ensure that our administrative processes are consistently accurate and our data remains reliable for all daily operations.

  

This role is primarily office\-based to support collaboration, teamwork, and visibility across the organisation. The HR Generalist is expected to work from the office 4 days per week, with 1 day per week working from home.

 **Key Responsibilities**


**Talent Acquisition Execution**


* Manage the full\-cycle recruitment process for all open roles, from initial sourcing on job boards, to conducting screenings and coordinating hiring manager interviews.
* Draft and maintain accurate job descriptions and ensure all vacancies are posted on relevant industry boards and the JOI Careers page.
* Manage the candidate pipeline within BambooHR, ensuring timely feedback and a professional candidate experience.
* Conduct pre\-employment due diligence, including reference checks and right\-to\-work verifications.

  


**HR Operations \& Compliance**


* Serve as the administrator for BambooHR, ensuring all employee data, digital files, and lifecycle changes (promotions, salary adjustments) are 100% accurate.
* Manage all local statutory requirements, including the timely filing of engagement and termination forms.
* Draft employment contracts, addenda, and termination letters in strict accordance with local legislation and GDPR.
* Oversee the offboarding process, ensuring the recovery of company assets and completion of statutory documentation.

  


**Payroll Preparation \& Benefits Administration**


* Prepare the monthly pay\-run by collecting data on leave, bonuses, salary changes, etc., liaising directly with the external payroll providers and Finance team.
* Administer all employee benefits, including, but not limited to, monetary allowances and occupational pension scheme.
* Act as the first point of contact for employees regarding payroll queries, policy clarifications, and leave entitlements.

  


**Benefits**


* €1,000 Annual Wellness Allowance.
* Relocation package available for those joining us from abroad.
* Wellness \& Work\-Life Balance
* Employee Assistance Program \- €250 per annum
* Birthday Leave – enjoy an extra day off to celebrate your special day
* Anniversary Leave – enjoy an extra day for every year at Joi Gaming.
* Friday Drinks \& Lunch – a weekly get\-together to connect with your team
* Hybrid work – 1 day from home per week after your 6\-month probation
* Remote work abroad – work from anywhere for up to 1 month per year
* Free parking for cars and motorbikes

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Share cv on hrd@naari.network

Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage end\-to\-end recruitment and onboarding for our growing building materials manufacturing company.

The role involves sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates across various functions including sales, technical, operations, and corporate roles. The candidate should be organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle from job posting to offer rollout
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, and referrals
* Screen profiles and conduct initial HR interviews
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate pipelines

2\. Stakeholder Coordination

* Work closely with department heads and hiring managers
* Understand role requirements and hiring priorities
* Ensure smooth interview scheduling and feedback collection

3\. Offer \& Onboarding

* Manage offer rollout and salary discussions
* Handle documentation and joining formalities
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new employees

4\. Recruitment Planning \& Reporting

* Track open positions and hiring progress
* Maintain candidate databases
* Provide regular recruitment updates to management

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Has strong recruitment and coordination skills
* Can manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously
* Is comfortable interacting with candidates and internal stakeholders
* Is proactive with follow\-ups and hiring closure

Qualification

Preferred:

* MBA / PGDM in HR / BBA / relevant HR qualification

Experience:

* 2–5 years experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
* Experience hiring for sales, technical, and operational roles
* Experience with job portals like Indeed, Naukri, LinkedIn etc.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Timely closure of open positions
* Quality of candidates hired
* Smooth onboarding experience
* Efficient recruitment coordination

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice period
* How many years of experience do you have in recruitment or talent acquisition and what type of industries?
* Do you have experience handling end\-to\-end recruitment including sourcing, interviewing, offer rollout, and onboarding?
* Which job portals or sourcing platforms have you used for recruitment?
* Have you previously handled recruitment for multiple roles simultaneously (sales, technical, operations etc.)?
* How many positions do you typically handle at the same time?

title: Jr. HR Associate (Talent Acquisition)
description:
**Be part of a high\-performing Recruitment team at one of America's fastest growing companies**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



This is Riza, the HR Manager at Fresh Prints.



If you had asked me five years ago whether I'd be leading recruitment, running cross\-functional projects, managing a team of talented HR Associates, building automations (despite coming from a non\-tech background), spearheading QA, and writing OKRs – all things that were completely alien to me at the time, I would've laughed and probably rolled my eyes.



I joined Fresh Prints during COVID as a fresh graduate, as part of a newly formed HR team, viewing it as a stepping stone before heading to business school. That plan took a sharp U\-turn when I was given opportunities to do far more than just "screen resumes" – to think critically about hiring, build systems, and help redefine what recruiting could look like in a fast\-growing startup.



I doubted myself at almost every step, but I took on the challenge to build a high\-functioning team and to redefine recruiting in a way that actually supports the business.



Almost five years in, we're a strong team of dedicated talent specialists spread across India and the Philippines. We've hired and retained over 400 employees in the past few years and learned a ton along the way; what scales, what breaks, and what truly moves the needle.



We're an experiment\-first team. We don't flinch at ideas, we love them. Have a compelling idea? Pitch it. We'll run with it. We're equally big on learning and iteration, and today, nearly 50% of our workflows are automated, freeing our talent associates to focus on strategy and execution.



Now, we're looking for strategists who execute. People who go beyond ticking off daily tasks and think about the bigger picture:


* How can HR enable the business?
* How can HR better support the Executive Team?
* How can HR lead world\-class talent acquisition that creates a seamless experience for candidates and hiring managers?


If this sounds exciting, and you have the energy to build, experiment, and own outcomes, I'd love to hear from you.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**



As a member of our Recruitment team, you're going to have a wide\-ranging group of responsibilities and goals. On a day\-to\-day basis, this means:


* Lead prospecting and headhunting efforts. Not just finding the right candidates, but nurturing relationships early and building long\-term pipelines
* Source candidates from diverse channels and screen resumes and applications with a strong quality bar
* Take hands\-on ownership of role coordination that goes beyond scheduling (much of which is automated) to stay closely involved in progress, blockers, and outcomes for each role
* Conduct interviews and coordinate multiple rounds of assessments
* Partner closely with hiring managers to align on role expectations, feedback, and hiring timelines
* Communicate clearly with management and team members to provide regular status updates
* Take on additional responsibilities as needed in a fast\-moving startup environment


**Qualifications:**


* Preferably 1\.5\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment
* Freshers are highly encouraged to apply
* Strong attention to detail with relentless follow\-up
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Experience in a start\-up environment is a huge plus
* Experience with in\-house recruitment is preferred


**Job Location:** Work From Home / Remote


**Working Hours:** 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday


**CTC:** Between $400 to $700, with a night allowance of $40

  



At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long\-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2\-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees.


**Fresh Prints never charges any money during the hiring process. If you're asked to pay for a job, it's not real.**


***Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity; actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ\+, and those with disabilities to apply.***

* **Physical Monitoring of Set\-Top Boxes (STBs) \-** Regular inspection and performance tracking of all deployed STBs.
* **CAS (Conditional Access System) Dashboard Monitoring \-** Real\-time monitoring of CAS dashboards to ensure subscriber access control and security.
* **Entitlement \& De\-entitlement Activities \-** Performing entitlement and de\-entitlement functions periodically as per operational requirements.

description:
**Job Profile: Plant Technician / Floor Assistant**

**Reporting to:** Lead CNC Operator / Production Manager / Welder/Fitter

**Objective:** To serve as a versatile technical resource on the production floor, ensuring seamless material flow, machine uptime, and supporting the senior fabrication team in achieving IRS/DNV Class\-certified output.

**1\. Detailed Scope of Work**

**A. CNC \& Forming Support:**

* **Material Staging:** Use the overhead crane to fetch and position 8m x 3m marine\-grade steel plates on the **Pro\-Arc Plasma** bed.
* **Post\-Cut Processing:** Immediately remove cut parts from the "skeleton" (scrap), perform edge\-grinding and de\-burring to prepare components for the welding stage.
* **Hydraulic Press Support:** Assist the operator in manual handling and positioning of large\-format A60/B15 panels during the **300T "Single\-Stroke"** forming process.

**B. Fabrication \& Assembly Support:**

* **Joint Preparation:** Prepare weld joints for the **6G Welders** by cleaning surfaces and grinding bevels to strict "contamination\-free" standards.
* **Assembly Assistance:** Hold, clamp, and align heavy door frames and hatches during the "fitting" process; assist in installing heavy\-duty hinges and locking "dogs."
* **Finishing:** Perform final slag removal, polishing, and buffing of finished products to meet Naval aesthetic and anti\-corrosion standards.

**C. Shop Floor Maintenance \& Asset Care:**

* **Daily Maintenance:** Execute the "First\-Hour" checklist (coolant levels, lubrication, air pressure) for all 4 major machines before the shift starts.
* **Scrap Monetization Support:** Systematically segregate and stack steel off\-cuts by grade (Grade A vs. DH36\) for efficient scrap recovery.
* **5S Compliance:** Maintain a clean and hazard\-free workspace; ensure welding gases and tools are stored safely to meet **IRS/DNV audit** standards.

**2\. Minimum Experience \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** **ITI (Fitter / Machinist / Welder)** or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment. (High\-aptitude freshers with strong blueprint reading skills are also eligible).
* **Aptitude:** Must be physically fit and capable of safely operating overhead cranes and heavy power tools.

**3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Machine Setup Speed:** Reducing the "idle time" between CNC runs by ensuring material is ready and loaded promptly.
* **Prep\-Quality:** Zero rejections from senior welders due to poor edge preparation or grinding errors.
* **Safety \& Cleanliness:** Achieving 100% compliance in the monthly "Safety \& 5S" internal audit.

description:
**Job Category:** Marketing
**Job Type:** Full Time
**Job Location:** Remote
Redhoney is a digital marketing agency focused on improving client performance. As we continue to grow, we seek an experienced Digital Ads Manager with a proven track record preferably in an agency setting to lead high\-impact digital advertising campaigns.


#### **Role Overview**


An SEO executive is responsible for optimizing a website to improve its visibility in search engine results, driving organic traffic and supporting business growth.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Keyword Research: SEO Executives identify the most effective keywords for content and website optimization by analyzing search volume, competition, and user intent using tools like Google Keyword Planner, SEMrush, or Ahrefs. This research informs content strategy and helps target the right audience at the right time.
* On\-Page SEO: They optimize website elements such as title tags, meta descriptions, headings, image alt texts, and internal linking. Ensuring a responsive, user\-friendly layout and proper keyword placement improves both search engine rankings and user experience.
* Technical SEO: SEO Executives manage backend website elements to enhance crawlability and indexing. Tasks include fixing crawl errors, improving site speed, managing redirects, ensuring mobile responsiveness, and implementing schema markup for better visibility.
* Content Collaboration: They work closely with content writers, designers, and marketers to create SEO\-friendly content that aligns with search intent, engages users, and drives conversions. This includes optimizing blogs, landing pages, and product pages.
* Off\-Page SEO and Link Building: Building high\-quality backlinks and improving website authority are key responsibilities. SEO Executives evaluate link opportunities and monitor competitor strategies to strengthen the site’s credibility.
* Analytics and Reporting: Monitoring website performance using tools like Google Analytics, they track traffic, rankings, and other KPIs. They produce reports and provide actionable recommendations to improve SEO outcomes.
* Continuous Learning and Strategy Adjustment: SEO is dynamic, so executives must stay updated on search engine algorithm changes and industry trends, adjusting strategies to maintain or improve rankings.
* Collaboration and Cross\-Functional Work: SEO Executives often coordinate with web developers, marketing teams, and digital strategists to ensure SEO best practices are implemented across all content and technical aspects of the website.

#### **Key Skills**


* SEO Analysis
